id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_150.pack|cs_: "Hey, Erik! Don't you dare slack off!
"What's that cheeky attitude! Forgotten we've looked after you two brats since you shivered in the snow ten years ago?
"Yelled at again. Big brother's so clumsy.
"Well, I get how you feel. I hate those guys too!
"Don't be so scared. Come on, finish quick and go home. I'll at least cheer you on.
"...No, help a little. He's mad today because you swiped his wallet.
"Shut up. Keep saying that and when I'm rich I won't share with you.
"Someday let's get a huge treasure together... and bid this rotten life goodbye.
"Heh heh... I'll get all the world's treasure and be super rich.
"...If I had wings, I could fly anywhere right now.
"So dumb. Brother's an idiot. ...Anyway, if we grill this, won't it taste good?"
